texts.en:
A healthy supply of £minerals£ Minerals, £alloys£ Alloys and £energy£ Energy Credits is critical to the well-being of any interstellar power. We should take steps to increase our production of these resources.

Stations and £building£ Buildings cost Alloys or Minerals to build and Energy Credits to maintain. The same is true for Ships, except that they have an Alloy upkeep cost as well. These resources are produced by £mining_station£ Mining Stations or Colony Buildings. 

Later you may discover new and interesting resources to spend on esoteric new production.
